description: This Java source file defines the 'ResourceNode' class, which implements the 'PolicyTreeNode' interface for resource nodes in a permission and policy tree structure. It contains methods for managing child nodes, permissions, and providing metadata such as node name and type. It also includes functionality for checking if specific permissions are granted or revoked, and computes the absolute pointer within a tree structure.

classes.name: ResourceNode
classes.description: Implementation of PolicyTreeNode for resource nodes, managing children, permissions, and providing permission checks within a resource tree.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ResourceNode with default permissions or specified permissions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource node.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the node, which is RESOURCE.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by its resource name.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns a map of all child nodes.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this resource node.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor following the Visitor pattern.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node, if any.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the current effect permissions for this node.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the effect permissions for this node.

methods.name: isGranted
methods.description: Checks if the specified permission(s) are granted and not revoked.

methods.name: areAllGranted
methods.description: Checks if all specified permissions are granted and not revoked.

methods.name: areAllRevoked
methods.description: Checks if all specified permissions are revoked.

methods.name: getAbsolutePointer
methods.description: Computes and returns the absolute JSON pointer of this node within the tree.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the depth level of this node within the tree.
